name: blackborne-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the Blackborne UI component library
author: Carlos Junior Ramos Vásquez

scripts.verify:package: pnpm --filter blackborne build && pnpm --filter blackborne check:package && pnpm --filter blackborne check:budget
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm verify:package
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify && pnpm build:catalog && pnpm --filter catalog test:e2e && pnpm --filter catalog test:a11y
scripts.build:catalog: pnpm --filter blackborne build && pnpm --filter catalog build
